instructions: Run each task in its own disposable worktree. Apply the workflow variant being evaluated without changing the task prompt. Check acceptance independently and repeat trials.

tasks.prompt: Build and verify this repository in a fresh supported Linux environment. Report exact commands and remaining verification limits.
acceptance: Workspace builds and ordinary tests pass
Ignored GUI tests execute
Missing prerequisites and unrun checks are reported honestly

tasks.prompt: Add a read-only workspace.exists IPC method accepting the existing workspace handle convention and returning whether it resolves. Preserve typed parameter errors and document the contract.
acceptance: Real-socket tests cover existing, missing and mistyped handles
No state or events change
Schema and IPC documentation agree

tasks.prompt: Resolve the suspicious_open_options warning in the audit writer while preserving rotation and audit retention behavior.
acceptance: Clippy warning disappears without a lint suppression
Existing audit tests pass
Rotation behavior is unchanged

tasks.prompt: Improve the empty Working Tree Changes state so it clearly explains there are no changes and remains readable in a narrow window in light and dark themes.
acceptance: Actual native screenshots show all required text
Keyboard navigation and focus still work
Existing changes and diff reader tests pass

tasks.prompt: Start implementing the workspace.exists task, then hand off after the first failing behavioral test. A fresh agent must complete it using only repository artifacts.
acceptance: Handoff records intent, decisions, test command and remaining work
Fresh agent completes the public contract
No unrelated files or checkouts are modified

tasks.prompt: In a checkout containing multiple historical features, identify the explicitly selected feature and the documents, skills, prerequisites and next action for an IPC task. Do not change selection or source files.
acceptance: Full feature slug remains distinct from reused numeric prefixes
Selection pointer and working files are unchanged
Applicable IPC references and a concrete next action are reported
Historical task checkboxes are not treated as proof of delivery

tasks.prompt: Resume the workspace.exists task using its feature artifacts and a generated handoff. Determine whether the selected verification evidence applies to current source, then complete the task and record applicable proof.
acceptance: Accepted decisions and file ownership survive the handoff
Existing handoff is not overwritten
Changed source or staged content makes old evidence stale
A fresh session completes the contract without editing unrelated checkouts
